consumer: A dialogue/condition u_has_item check (condition.cpp set_has_item) asking 'does the avatar possess at least one knife_combat?' as a computed yes/no possession predicate.
scope: The character's own carried items INCLUDING items nested inside worn/inventory containers (on-person possession), not just top-level wielded/worn/inv stacks.
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_item — returns actor->charges_of(item_id) > 0 || actor->has_amount(item_id, 1), the engine-computed possession verdict, backed by src/visitable.cpp::visit_internal which recurses into container contents.
divergence: A knife_combat tucked inside a worn backpack (a container): the engine predicate has_amount() recurses via visit_items and returns true, but a top-level read of write_carried_items' inv_const_slice/wielded/worn iteration misses the nested item and reports 'not carrying', a false negative.
